notes: Planned data-centre campus of up to 1,000 MW in Skellefteå. No public commissioning schedule has been announced; development depends on permitting.

AI-centre investment framework of up to SEK 95 billion in Strängnäs. The project expands an earlier/base 300 MW plan to 750 MW, but electricity supply and final scope remain unresolved in later reporting; no precise commissioning schedule has been publicly identified.
EcoDataCenter campus at Kvarnsveden. First halls are planned for 2027 with at least 250 MW capacity; the campus can scale to around 600 MW over time.
Planned 300 MW campus at Hamre Industrial Park in Sollefteå. The site is prepared for high-density racks and expected to enter operation in H1 2028.

The 2025 Form 10-K reports litigation seeking rescission of the SAPL transaction connected to Marviken agreements. Scope, rights and delivery schedule need fresh verification; the old phased dates are not a current execution forecast.
The annual report records the September 2025 decision not to proceed with Östersund. Preserve historical identity and announced capacity; exclude from future scenarios.
Concept-stage SMR-linked data centre at Studsvik. Memorandum of understanding concerns supply from small modular reactors of around 55 MW per reactor; no data-centre load estimate is identified.
Planned atNorth SWE02 metro data centre in Kista, close to SWE01. Expected to enter operation in Q4 2027 with 30 MW capacity, heat-recovery integration and a new customer substation.
Conapto Stockholm 5 North. First phase around 14 MW IT capacity with 28 MW power supply by June 2027; full plan exceeds 28 MW IT capacity, corresponding to approximately 40 MW power supply, by 2029.
Mistral AI and EcoDataCenter partnership for an AI-focused data centre at the Borlänge campus. Expected to open in 2027 with approximately 23 MW compute capacity.

Evroc flagship AI data centre in Arlandastad with 18 MW capacity. The February 2025 release described up to 16,000 GPUs, while evroc's current data-center page describes up to 10,000 GPUs and says the site is being built; operation is still targeted for H2 2026.
Expansion of Conapto Stockholm 4 South adding 8 MW and increasing the facility from 20 MW to 28 MW. Additional capacity expected to be available on 1 January 2026.
ScandiDC data centre developed in a rock cavern in Eskilstuna. Phase 1 of up to 6 MW is expected to be completed in Q4 2026; the site is prepared for up to 10 MW IT load.
Expansion of GlobalConnect’s existing data centre in southern Stockholm. Adds 1.2 MW and increases the facility to 2.7 MW, with launch expected in 2026.
Google announced site construction start on 2 June 2026. This does not establish a datacentre MW load or execution of the entire permitted backup-power envelope.
